name: message-bubble
title: Message Bubble
description: A speech bubble that pops in, with an optional reaction badge that springs onto its corner.
useWhen: Hand-timing a single message landing on a beat you control.
A scene needs a themed speech bubble around text.
The conversation should carry your own theme tokens rather than a real messenger's palette.
avoidWhen: You want a whole scripted conversation with a composer, typing beats and reactions: use chat-flow.
The bubble must read as a specific messenger with a tail or timestamp.
You need the bouncing dots themselves: use typing-indicator.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Variant
variables.description: Incoming sits left in the muted tone, outgoing sits right in the primary tone.

variables.label: Reaction
variables.description: Emoji badge on the bubble. Leave empty for none.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the scripted interaction. 2 plays it twice as fast and holds the end.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the control sits over your own scene.
